scope: Read-only independent union audit of all rows in the fixed UniBa v3 and ITU external manifests
method: For each split and raw EEG SHA-256, sort half-open [window_end_s - duration, window_end_s) intervals, merge overlaps, then sum union lengths. Check that the cropped interval lies inside the stored full window. Durations audited: full 1.75 seconds and the last 1.0 second.
classification: No source-level temporal overlap exists in either audited selection. Selected source-interval seconds are not total acquired recording hours or epoch-repeated exposure.
split_isolation: No manifest rows or partitions were changed by this audit.
limits: Grouping by raw EEG content SHA-256 identifies a recording representation, not globally distinct humans or semantically duplicate re-exports.
EEG-LLM v3 consumes the original 1.75-second window; the new CBraMod symbol model consumes only its last 1.0 second.
At 30 complete epochs, 400 selected training seconds are presented 30 times; this is 12000 seconds of repeated input, not 12000 new seconds.
ITU rows are external evaluation only; their duration is not training data.
